item.title: ‘We will pay,’ Savannah Guthrie says in desperate video plea to potential kidnappers of her mother
item.description: Savannah Guthrie has told the potential kidnappers of her mother Nancy Guthrie that the family is prepared to pay for her safe return. The “Today” show host appeared in a video on Instagram on Saturday while flanked by her two siblings. She said: “We received your message and we understand. ... This is very valuable to us, and we will pay.” The FBI says Savannah Guthrie was referencing a message that was sent to the Tucson television station KOLD on Friday. item.title: Ukraine businesses struggle to cope as Russian attacks bring power cuts and uncertainty
item.description: While businesses were prepared for electricity cuts due to Russian missile and drone attacks on Ukraine’s energy infrastructure, no one expected such a brutal winter. Hourslong outages of electricity, water and heating in subzero temperatures mean much of Ukraine is reliant on generators to keep the lights on. For businesses the cost burden can be immense.
